baseline_identifiability.reason: The primary comparator B-SHALLOW-MATCHED-DT is the other stratum of the same live fetch-complete frame, same instrument, same UA, same measured separation, so treatment-vs-comparator differences cannot be explained by vantage, transport, instrument or time-window drift. The DESIGN full-cap sweep (P8, exact frozen module) established that both strata are large, host-diverse and not ceiling/floor: deep 686 / shallow 421 paired-capable pages, all four hosts contributing >=25 pages to each stratum (M-HOSTS-WITH-BOTH-STRATA expected 4 >= MIN_HOSTS_BOTH=2), max host concentration 0.321 < 0.60, max version-pinned fraction 0.032 << 0.80 (96.8% of deep pages are MOVING_ALIAS), so a deep-stratum zero would be measured rather than true by construction. Floor is also excluded: the offline injection controls prove the primary channel fires on visible-text change, and the positive control is externally volatile content, not a synthetic tautology. The estimand is text-channel change with the byte channel reported beside every text bound (M-HAZARD-BYTE-UB95-*), so the conservative sensitivity comparator cannot be omitted from the cost of blindness. The secondary B-RETRO-LONG-DT channel is real second-observation data (parent census hashes + parent provenance window), declared SECONDARY and structurally unable to change the primary label. Host x depth and URL-class confounds are disclosed and narrowed by V10 tags rather than ignored.

control_sensitivity.reason: Positive and null controls can both behave correctly under the same hash-pinned module that will score EXECUTE. Offline fixture canaries (freshly re-run under review, 35/35) prove the primary channel fires on injected visible-text change (C-DETECT-TEXT-INJECTION), is blind to attribute-only and script-nonce-only churn while the byte channel sees them (C-DETECT-ATTR-ONLY, C-DETECT-SCRIPT-ONLY), detects a fixture 404 into the censoring channel (C-CENSOR-404-DETECTED), and stays silent on two identical fixture GETs (C-LIVE-DETECTOR-ON-FIXTURE). Live: the positive gate requires >=1 of 3 pre-registered volatile URLs to show a PRIMARY-CHANNEL text change between observations and >=2 of 3 to return 200; the DESIGN selection disclosure (6-URL pool, 3 fired / 2 stable / 1 unreachable within <=5 s) is auditable and non-post-hoc; a single-GET review canary confirmed all three still return HTTP 200. The null family requires M-LIVE-NULL-CHANGED==0 on two frozen static anchors with both 200 at obs1, and M-SELFPAIR-CHANGED==0 across 10 in-frame self-pairs with gap <=5 s — the self-pair family runs inside the measured frame itself and is the stronger detector-noise null for multi-megabyte documentation pages. Any positive-control failure or null/self-pair change is a hard MEASUREMENT_INVALID that forbids a zero-event interpretation (mandate stop trigger), so the controls are neither tautological nor impossible. Residual risk that a 5 s-volatile URL is text-stable at ~360 s is fail-closed, not a path to false certification.

treatment_liveness.reason: There is no classical treatment arm; the live mechanism is the fetch-complete, stratum-reserved, level-ordered BFS census (the repair of the parent's discover-until-budget starvation), and its liveness is that the deep stratum is actually fetched. That was demonstrated on the bound hosts with the exact frozen module (self-hash matching DERIVED_SHA256) at the frozen full caps before freeze: deep 686 / shallow 421 admitted, hop histogram reaching level 5, all four hosts contributing to both strata with >=25 pages each, 1107 HTTP 200 of 1119 rows, 37.26 s wall, ~24.5 GET/s. The tiny-cap smoke (SHALLOW_CAP=22, DEEP_CAP=6) confirmed the descent rule itself: 4/4 hosts still reached hop 3 with 24/24 HTTP 200 deep pages, i.e. the deep stratum survives shallow-budget exhaustion — the exact parent failure mode (90.3% of discovered deep URLs never fetched, 2 of 4 hosts). Instrument identity is re-pinnable at EXECUTE via V1-CODE-IDENTITY, and a review re-extraction of the FROZEN_CODE block reproduced DERIVED_SHA256 exactly. The mechanism is therefore non-null and executable before any expensive arm; the parent's synthetic-only liveness gap (AUD-DESIGN-SATIFIABILITY-GAP) is structurally closed on the real substrate.

nonblocking_findings.detail: spec.json#claim_ceiling_rules.CC-E and baselines[1].declared_limits state '253 of 292 reference pages are hop<=2'; an independent recount of parent census.jsonl restricted to status=200 and non-null sha256 gives 261 hop<=2 and 31 hop>=3. The direction of the caveat (retro channel is shallow-biased and readthedocs-heavy) is unchanged; only the exact split is off by 8 pages. Does not affect the primary decision rule.

B-RETRO-LONG-DT admission requires the measured median window in [6 h, 30 d] from parent scored_run_finished (2026-10-17T00:46:04Z). If EXECUTE were to run before ~06:46Z on 2026-10-17 the secondary channel would be frozen-out by its own gate. Given DESIGN probes completed at 14:25-14:36Z the same day, ordinary freeze-then-execute ordering lands well inside the window; the gate is frozen and disclosed, so this is an operational note, not a design defect.

Positive-control candidates were selected on <=5 s double-GET volatility (prereg.md#15 P4), while the EXECUTE gate measures change over ~360 s. All three frozen positives are time/token-bearing endpoints (cdn-cgi/trace ts/fl, rate_limit counters, timeapi current time), so text-channel change at 360 s is structurally expected; if any nevertheless fails to fire, the disposition is hard MEASUREMENT_INVALID / stop-trigger rather than a weakened gate.

frame_ok requires M-DT-MAX-S <= DT_MAX_S=900 over all pairs. A single late observation-1 fetch with dt>900 would void the whole measurement even if the bulk of pairs sit near 360 s. At measured throughput (~24.5 GET/s over ~1107 obs1 targets, ~45 s of spread) the tail is expected near ~405 s, far below the ceiling; the fail-closed behaviour is disclosed in V5 and is preferable to silent inclusion of short/long lags.
